description: Staging site of a hosted WordPress website (Backsies Pro; the Backsies plugin must be connected). action status (default) shows the copy (address, when copied, last push and until when it can be undone) and any running job with its phase and percent; tables lists the copy"s database tables for a push, with which are pushed by default (live data such as users, orders and comments is not); create (media copy|link: link shows media from live to save space) makes a private copy at staging.<domain>: sign-in only, no search engines, no e-mail, no cron, offline payment methods only; refresh replaces the copy with a fresh copy of live; push sends changed files (files, default true) and tables (table names without prefix, or ["default"]) to live after backing live up, keeping what it replaced for 7 days; undo puts back what the last push replaced; delete removes the copy and staging.<domain>; dismiss clears a finished or failed job. Jobs run on the site in steps; follow with status. create, refresh, push, undo and delete need confirmation.

action.description: status (default) shows the staging copy and any running job; tables lists tables for a push; create, refresh (from live), push (to live), undo (last push) and delete need confirmation; dismiss clears a finished job.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

files.description: push: send files changed on staging (default true).

media.description: create: copy media, or show it from live to save space.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

tables.description: push: table names without prefix (from tables), or ["default"] for all but live data (users, orders, comments).

name: oma_backsies_staging
title: Backsies staging site
